craft_notes: Sthāyin: parokṣa-dīkṣā unit 12. Sanskrit-first kept. Rows: 8. Close: rest. Rejected: smoothing — killed: flagged. Read aloud: steady cadence.

lines: For the uninitiated, king and the rest, the lazy, the fallen, the dead, child, sick, woman, old — and one should arrange the redemption of the dead.
l4.sanskrit_cite: adīkṣite nṛpatyādāvalase patite mṛte bālāturastrīvṛddhe ca mṛtoddhāraṃ prakalpayet
